relationships.subject: TRPV1 antagonists
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 antagonists can induce analgesia, but hyperthermia and thermal hypesthesia side effects have limited their utility.

key_findings: TRPV1-expressing nociceptors in the knee are a rational target for KOA pain.
Capsaicin and resiniferatoxin provide proof-of-concept for TRPV1 modulation in KOA.
